name: principals
description: Provider-independent application principal for one human identity at one issuer; its UUID is the stable identity referenced by memberships, ownership and audit.
lifecycle: Created at first verified login; never deleted by the runtime. Disablement is a state change. Retention and erasure follow PH-13.

columns.Meaning: Application-generated immutable principal UUID, written to the provider's administrator-only attribute and asserted by access tokens as orion_principal_id.
Exact OIDC issuer that authenticated this principal; together with subject it is the provider association.
Provider-assigned stable subject identifier at the issuer; never used as the application identity.
ACTIVE principals can hold sessions; DISABLED principals are globally denied within the 30-second revocation bound.
Presentation name from the last verified login; never used as identity or authorization evidence.
columns.Null meaning: No bounded display name has been obtained from a verified login.

columns.Meaning: Presentation email snapshot from the last verified login; never used to link accounts, grant access or accept invitations.
columns.Null meaning: No bounded verified email snapshot has been obtained.

constraints.Purpose: A disablement instant exists exactly for disabled principals.
A presentation name, when present, cannot be blank.
Issuer is an absolute HTTP(S) URL without whitespace.
A verified-login email snapshot, when present, cannot be blank.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX principals_issuer_subject_key ON public.principals USING btree (issuer, subject)
constraints.Purpose: One application principal per provider identity; concurrent first logins converge on one row.
